info.title: fitcheck-mealtracker-service API
info.description: Creates and manages user meal logs from multiple sources, calculates per-item and meal-level nutrition totals, stores immutable daily consumption snapshots, and exposes daily progress, weekly, and monthly analytics APIs.

post.description:
This operation requires session parameters: userId (ID, required).
To access the route, the session should have roles: **[superAdmin]**.

201.description: Response JSON represents the most comprehensive form of the **mealLog** object in the response. However, some properties may be omitted based on the object's internal logic.
